svg.title: Which check catches which mutant
svg.text: Each row is a broken program builder; green = the check noticed (Chapter 8's mutation table)
scores: the 1/sqrt(d) factor is left out
scores: the factor 16 (Q4.4 input of the softmax) is left out
weights: the factor 127 is left out
output: the scale leaves out the 127
output: uses the key scale instead of the value scale
q projection is requantized with the key weights' scale
q requantization scale is 3% too large
output requantization scale is 2% too large
keys are read without the transpose
the value matrix stride is 4 instead of d
score tiles step through the keys by 4 words, not 4 rows
the new key is written one row past the cache end
the new key is never appended to the cache
the new value is appended to the key cache
the key cache load is one row short
the new token's hidden state is read from row 0
the softmax covers one position too few
the weights are requantized with the scores' parameters
the q projection uses the K weights
recompute: V is projected with the K weights
the output requantization covers 8 of 16 values
the output is stored from the int32 accumulators
no single check catches every mutant; the union catches all 23
